title: Malign swarm-like NHI in DeLonge's books, Elizondo's hints and the Cryptoterrestrial Conundrum

tellings.quote: The thing basically in the Tom Deong books or things that Alzando has hinted at. Um you know they've drawn and even the book uh Crypto's conundrum. Uhhuh. It's they all address this idea of like the the bad NHI or the malign.

plain: Several sources share the idea that some NHI, short for non-human intelligence, are hostile and act like a swarm: the books of Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who founded a UFO research company; hints from Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken publicly about UFOs; and a book called Cryptoterrestrial Conundrum. The analyst Matthew Pines points this out to Michels in his own summary, saying 'they all address this idea of the bad NHI, or the malign.' If true, it would mean not every visitor is friendly.
